sources.label: Recreation and Park Commission minutes, San Francisco Public Library (Internet Archive)

historical_record.description: Noting the park had seen no major capital work since it was laid out in the 19th century, the Recreation and Park Commission approved renovating McKinley Square on Potrero Hill: an enlarged play area with new swings and play structures, picnic tables and benches inside a low fence, new paths with four gated entrances, and a disabled access ramp.
